profile.headline: Expert Full Stack Software Engineer Consultant | State Religious Affairs NCO | Owner of Deevtech
profile.jobTitle: Expert Full Stack Software Engineer Consultant
profile.summary:
Currently, I am a Full Stack Software Engineer Consultant, working on a project helping our clients Chemistry Scientist gain better insights into their experiments by developing a new web app that maps millions of experiments in to synthesis route networks with all the relevant data points at their fingertips resulting in hundreds of hours of gathering data manually allowing them to focus more on analysis and decision making much faster than ever before.

I am also a Religious Affairs NCO for the Iowa Army National Guard. As a Religious Affairs NCO, my goal is to build relationships of trust with the soldiers around me in order that they may come to me with issues that can be solved through counseling, guidance or just vent to get something off their chest.  I serve at the Brigade level Unit Ministry Team, where we have the opportunity to mentor all the Battalion UMTs within our Brigade.

positions.title: Expert Full Stack Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description: Developing a new React Web app and Apollo Graphql API in AWS to surface chemistry experiment data from the client's ELN(Electronic Lab Notebook), using BIOVIA and rdkit Chemistry DB cartridges and Marvin JS drawing tools.  Building algorithms to produce chemical synthesis route networks to help R&D chemistry scientists decision-making efficient and have collaborative decisions across labs.

positions.title: MSG - JFHQ State Religious Affairs NCO
positions.description: As the State Religious Affairs NCO, I work out of the JFHQ Chaplains Office and I help care for and mentor all members of the Iowa Army National Guard Chaplain Corps.  I help Plan, resource, supervise, conduct, and evaluate staff training for religious affairs specialists. Monitor and recommend religious affairs specialist personnel assignments and utilization to the command.  Conduct UMT staff assistance visits and organization inspections of UMT activities, training, facilities, performance, and professional development and growth.

positions.title: SFC - JFHQ Deputy State Religious Affairs NCO
positions.description:
As the Deputy State Religious Affairs NCO, I work out of the JFHQ Chaplains Office and I help care for and mentor all members of the Iowa Army National Guard Chaplain Corps.  I help Plan, resource, supervise, conduct, and evaluate staff training for religious affairs specialists. Monitor and recommend religious affairs specialist personnel assignments and utilization to the command.  Conduct UMT staff assistance visits and organization inspections of UMT activities, training, facilities, performance, and professional development and growth.

Traveled to Kosovo in March 2022 to continue assisting the Kosovo Security Forces in the development of their own Chaplain Corps though the State Partnership Program.

positions.title: SSG - 2/34 IBCT Brigade Religious Affairs NCO
positions.description: As the Brigade Religious Affairs NCO, I was over six Battalion Unit Ministry Teams throughout the state.  We were in charge of mentoring and monitoring our Battalion UMTs as well as helping them grow and achieve their goals. Deployed to Kosovo 2020-2021.  Assisted the Kosovo Security Force in developing their own Chaplain Corps. from the ground up.

positions.title: SGT - 1034th CSSB & 1-133 INF Battalion Religious Affairs NCO
positions.description:
Religious affairs NCO's use their technical religious support expertise to assist the commander and chaplain in shaping the environment to accomplish the commander’s religious support mission.   Religious affairs NCO's apply their skills along three core capabilities: integrating religious operations, spiritual fitness, and basic human interaction tasks. Religious affairs NCO's integrate religious support operations in the JIIM (Joint Inter-agency Intergovernmental and Multinational) environment, and within unified land operations at the tactical, operational, and strategic levels.

Deployed to Afghanistan 2012-2013, traveled providing religious services and support.  Lead worship services, bible studies, morale events, and training.

positions.title: PVT-SPC - 1034th CSSB Battalion Religious Affairs Specialist
positions.description: I Entred the Iowa Army National Guard as a Religious Affairs specialist. Completed Basic Training, Chaplain Assistant Advanced Individual Training, Basic Leaders Course.  Learned my role as a Battalion Chaplain Assistant.  Was promoted to Cadre over RSP A Co. where I trained over 140+ soldiers in Basic Military operations, marching, movements, values, and physical training to prepare them for Basic Training.

volunteerExperiences.description:
What is HyperStream:
HyperStream is a program developed and managed by the Technology Association of Iowa fosters real-world learning for 5th-12th graders through hands-on technology projects, competitions, showcases and engaging presentations through after-school clubs or integrated into curriculum, combined with the opportunity to work with technology mentors. 

My Role: 
As a mentor I give students a real-world, inside look at technology, and help them with projects they’re working on.  I currently assist high school students learn the basics of programming and application development, through MIT App Inventor 2.  MIT App Inventor is an IDE designed by Google, and Maintained by MIT to help teach students how to code and program real world applications.  This tool allows students create Android apps that they can play and use instantly on their Android device.

Why: 
My passion for volunteering for HyperStream, comes from my first programming class in college.  I always loved technology but I was scared that program was going to be way too difficult.  Yet I took the plunge anyway and it changed my life!  Now I love coding, it was not as difficult as I thought it would be, and it's not all ones and zeros like I thought it was, it's a way more than that.  You can create anything you want, your only limited by your imagination. My goal is to show students that they can do it too, and not be scared of coding, it is fun, rewarding and an amazing career choice to pursue.

volunteerExperience.description:
What is HyperStream:
HyperStream is a program developed and managed by the Technology Association of Iowa fosters real-world learning for 5th-12th graders through hands-on technology projects, competitions, showcases and engaging presentations through after-school clubs or integrated into curriculum, combined with the opportunity to work with technology mentors. 

My Role: 
As a mentor I give students a real-world, inside look at technology, and help them with projects they’re working on.  I currently assist high school students learn the basics of programming and application development, through MIT App Inventor 2.  MIT App Inventor is an IDE designed by Google, and Maintained by MIT to help teach students how to code and program real world applications.  This tool allows students create Android apps that they can play and use instantly on their Android device.

Why: 
My passion for volunteering for HyperStream, comes from my first programming class in college.  I always loved technology but I was scared that program was going to be way too difficult.  Yet I took the plunge anyway and it changed my life!  Now I love coding, it was not as difficult as I thought it would be, and it's not all ones and zeros like I thought it was, it's a way more than that.  You can create anything you want, your only limited by your imagination. My goal is to show students that they can do it too, and not be scared of coding, it is fun, rewarding and an amazing career choice to pursue.
